by_category:
by_category
	| totals result |
	totals := Dictionary new.
	(state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) do: [ :each |
		| c |
		c := each at: 'category'.
		totals at: c put: (totals at: c ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) + (self cents_of: (each at: 'amount')) ].
	result := Dictionary new.
	totals keysAndValuesDo: [ :c :v | result at: c put: (self money_from_cents: v) ].
	^ result
total:
total
	| cents |
	cents := (state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ])
		inject: 0
		into: [ :sum :each | sum + (self cents_of: (each at: 'amount')) ].
	^ self money_from_cents: cents
top_category:
top_category
	| totals best bestCents |
	totals := self by_category.
	totals isEmpty ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
	best := nil.
	bestCents := -1.
	totals keys asSortedCollection do: [ :c |
		| cents |
		cents := self cents_of: (totals at: c).
		cents > bestCents ifTrue: [ best := c. bestCents := cents ] ].
	^ best
over_budget:
over_budget
	| spent budgets over |
	spent := self by_category.
	budgets := state at: 'budgets' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	over := budgets keys select: [ :c |
		(self cents_of: (spent at: c ifAbsent: [ 0 ])) > (self cents_of: (budgets at: c)) ].
	^ over asSortedCollection asArray
add_expense:
add_expense: amount category: category
	^ self record: amount category: category note: nil

add_expense: amount category: category note: note
	(note isKindOf: String) ifFalse: [ self error: 'breaks expenses-shape' ].
	note isEmpty ifTrue: [ self error: 'note must not be empty' ].
	^ self record: amount category: category note: note
money_from_cents:
money_from_cents: cents
	^ cents = 0 ifTrue: [ 0 ] ifFalse: [ cents / 100.0 ]
record:
record: amount category: category note: note
	| expenses entry |
	amount isNumber ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be a number' ].
	amount > 0 ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be greater than zero' ].
	(category isNil or: [ category isEmpty ]) ifTrue: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	entry := Dictionary new
		at: 'amount' put: amount;
		at: 'category' put: category;
		yourself.
	note ifNotNil: [ entry at: 'note' put: note ].
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	expenses add: entry.
	^ expenses size
set_budget:
set_budget: category amount: amount
	| budgets |
	(category isNil or: [ category isEmpty ]) ifTrue: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	amount isNumber ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be a number' ].
	(amount * 100) rounded < 0 ifTrue: [ self error: 'amount must not be negative' ].
	budgets := state at: 'budgets' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ].
	budgets at: category put: amount.
	^ amount
